findings.title: Ambiguous filter propagation between tables: Date, Product, Sales, Sales Target
evidence: 'Date' reaches 'Sales Target' through 2 active paths: Date -> Sales Target | Date -> Sales -> Product -> Sales Target
findings.explanation: More than one active, direction-compatible path connects the same tables.
findings.impact: Filter results depend on which path the engine uses; Power BI may also refuse to activate one of the relationships.
findings.recommendation: Make one relationship inactive or single-direction so only one path remains.
findings.verification: Open Model view in Power BI Desktop and check for ambiguity warnings; test the affected measures.

findings.title: Unrelated tables combined in 'Customer Accounts' (tableEx) on page 'Overview': 'Account' and 'Customer'
evidence: Columns from 'Account' and 'Customer' in the same tableEx
No active relationship path between them in either direction
findings.explanation: Power BI cannot use relationships to restrict combinations of these columns.
findings.impact: The visual may list rows that look unrelated (e.g., all accounts for each customer) or show a relationship error.
findings.recommendation: Activate/create the relationship path or add a measure that defines the link.
findings.verification: Run: pbip-forensics investigate --from-table "Account" --to-table "Customer".

findings.title: FILTER over entire table 'Sales' used as CALCULATE filter in '_Measures'[High Value Revenue]
findings.explanation: A table filter iterates every row of the (expanded) table and keeps all its columns as filter.
findings.impact: Often slower than a column predicate and may filter related tables more than intended.
findings.recommendation: Use column predicates (e.g., 'T'[Col] > x) or FILTER(VALUES('T'[Col]), ...); add KEEPFILTERS if the intent is to intersect with existing filters.
findings.verification: Compare query duration (Performance Analyzer / DAX query view) before and after the change.

findings.title: Nested iterators AVERAGEX > SUMX in '_Measures'[Avg Customer Spend]
evidence: SUMX is evaluated inside the row expression of AVERAGEX
findings.explanation: The inner iteration runs once per row of the outer iteration.
findings.impact: Cost grows with the product of both cardinalities; risk depends on data volume.
findings.recommendation: Pre-aggregate (SUMMARIZE/ADDCOLUMNS with a measure) or move logic to a column if static.
findings.verification: Measure server timings in DAX query view or DAX Studio with realistic filters.

findings.title: Context transition per row of 'Sales' in 'Sales'[Sales Per Row]
findings.explanation: Referencing a measure inside an iterator triggers context transition for every row.
findings.impact: On large fact tables this can be expensive and may duplicate rows with identical values.
findings.recommendation: Iterate a dimension or VALUES of a key column instead of the fact table.
findings.verification: Compare duration and results with the alternative formulation.

findings.title: Bidirectional relationship: Sales <-> Product
findings.explanation: Bidirectional cross-filtering lets the many side filter the one side, which can create additional filter paths.
findings.impact: Possible ambiguity, unexpected filtering of dimensions and slower queries.
findings.recommendation: Prefer single direction; use CROSSFILTER(..., BOTH) inside specific measures if required.
findings.verification: Check whether slicers on related dimensions change unexpectedly when this table is filtered.

findings.title: Key data type mismatch: Sales Target[ProductKey] vs Product[ProductKey]
findings.explanation: Relationship key columns have different declared data types.
findings.impact: Implicit conversion can cause unmatched keys (blank member) and slower joins.
findings.recommendation: Align the data types in Power Query.
findings.verification: Look for a (Blank) member when slicing by the one-side table.

findings.title: Total may differ from the sum of visible rows: '_Measures'[Bonus]
evidence: IF/SWITCH evaluated on measure values without iterating rows: at the total level the condition is evaluated once on the aggregate
findings.explanation: Power BI evaluates the measure again in the total's filter context; it does not sum the rows.
findings.impact: Users may perceive totals as wrong.
findings.recommendation: If the total must be the sum of rows, iterate the grouping column (SUMX(VALUES(...), [Measure])).
findings.verification: Export the visible rows, sum them, and compare with the total for the same filters.

findings.title: Total may differ from the sum of visible rows: '_Measures'[Segment Revenue]
evidence: IF/SWITCH evaluated on measure values without iterating rows: at the total level the condition is evaluated once on the aggregate
uses HASONEVALUE, SELECTEDVALUE: total rows follow a different branch by design
findings.explanation: Power BI evaluates the measure again in the total's filter context; it does not sum the rows.
findings.impact: Users may perceive totals as wrong.
findings.recommendation: If the total must be the sum of rows, iterate the grouping column (SUMX(VALUES(...), [Measure])).
findings.verification: Export the visible rows, sum them, and compare with the total for the same filters.

findings.title: Division operator '/' with a non-constant denominator in '_Measures'[Revenue Safe]
findings.explanation: The '/' operator raises an error/infinity when the denominator is zero or blank.
findings.impact: Visuals may show errors or Infinity for some selections.
findings.recommendation: Use DIVIDE(numerator, denominator) to handle zero denominators.
findings.verification: Select a slice where the denominator is zero or blank.

findings.title: Division operator '/' with a non-constant denominator in '_Measures'[Margin %]

findings.title: Error-handling function in '_Measures'[Revenue Safe]
findings.explanation: IFERROR/ISERROR can force slower evaluation and hide data problems.
findings.impact: Possible performance cost; masked errors.
findings.recommendation: Prefer DIVIDE or explicit checks.
findings.verification: Compare query durations with and without the error handler.

findings.title: Inactive relationship not activated by any measure: Account -> Customer
evidence: No USERELATIONSHIP reference found in any measure
findings.explanation: This relationship does not propagate filters and no measure in the model activates it.
findings.impact: Selections on 'Customer' will not filter 'Account' through this relationship; visuals may show unrelated rows or repeated totals.
findings.recommendation: Activate it, remove it, or add measures that use USERELATIONSHIP where needed.
findings.verification: Place a column of 'Customer' and a column/measure of 'Account' in a table visual and observe whether rows are restricted.

findings.title: Disconnected table not referenced by any measure: Currency
findings.explanation: Filters on this table cannot propagate to any other table.
findings.impact: Slicers or visuals combining this table with other tables will not filter them.
findings.recommendation: Create the missing relationship or remove the table if unused.
findings.verification: Add a slicer from this table next to a measure from a fact table and check if values change.

findings.title: REMOVEFILTERS modifies filter context in '_Measures'[Revenue All Customers]
findings.explanation: REMOVEFILTERS removes (or restores) filters on 'Customer' for this calculation.
findings.impact: Selections on those objects do not restrict this measure; this is a common cause of 'measure ignores my slicer'.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the intent; use KEEPFILTERS or narrower column targets if selections must apply.
findings.verification: Apply a slicer on the target and compare this measure with its base measure.

findings.title: Total may differ from the sum of visible rows: '_Measures'[Active Customers]
evidence: DISTINCTCOUNT is non-additive: the total is not the sum of rows
findings.explanation: Power BI evaluates the measure again in the total's filter context; it does not sum the rows.
findings.impact: Users may perceive totals as wrong.
findings.recommendation: If the total must be the sum of rows, iterate the grouping column (SUMX(VALUES(...), [Measure])).
findings.verification: Export the visible rows, sum them, and compare with the total for the same filters.

findings.title: Inactive relationship activated only by DAX: Sales -> Date
evidence: Activated via USERELATIONSHIP in: Revenue by Ship Date
findings.explanation: Inactive relationships never propagate filters unless a measure activates them.
findings.impact: Only the listed measures respond to filters through this path; all other measures ignore it.
findings.recommendation: Confirm this is intentional (e.g., role-playing date) and document the activating measures.
findings.verification: In a table visual, compare a listed measure against a non-activating measure for the same selection.
